import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(41.6, 43.7)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(21.85)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(21.85)
    )
)
result = result.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').cylinder(387.0,10.49))
show_object(result)
